message: The other day, I decided it was time to check our emergency go-bags. Instead of it feeling like a chore, I turned it into a little family event. We gathered around the living room, made some hot cocoa, and went through each item together, sharing stories about why we chose them. 🥰 It felt less like prepping for a ‘what if’ and more like bonding over our family’s little adventure plans. How do you make preparedness a cozy affair at home?
